title: Final Mile Ops Checklist and SLO Sampler
body:
Purpose:
A compact, operational "final-mile" checklist and quick SLO sampler to be used in the 72-hour window before full traffic cutover. Designed for product-ops + cross-functional launch leads to run a lightweight readiness sweep, capture signal deltas, and trigger contingency actions.

How to use: (1) Run the Quick Scoreboard every 6 hours during the ramp. (2) If any metric hits the orange threshold, notify on #launch-ops and tag SRE/Platform. (3) If red threshold reached, execute the immediate fallback play and escalate to the on-call committee.

Quick Scoreboard (rows are monitored every 6h):
- API p95 latency | Target: < 200ms | Orange: 200-350ms | Red: >350ms | Owner: eng-sre | Measurement: synthetic + prod traces
- Token cost per 1k reqs (typical prompt) | Target: < $0.85 | Orange: $0.85-$1.20 | Red: >$1.20 | Owner: product-ops | Measurement: billing pipeline
- Error rate (5m rolling) | Target: < 0.1% | Orange: 0.1-0.5% | Red: >0.5% | Owner: eng-platform | Measurement: frontend + backend aggregated
- Model-quality regression (eval set) | Target: delta F1 <= 0.02 | Orange: 0.02-0.06 | Red: >0.06 | Owner: applied-ml | Measurement: daily eval job
- KV-cache hit rate | Target: > 30% | Orange: 20-30% | Red: <20% | Owner: serving-runtime | Measurement: runtime metrics
- Autoscale breach events per hour | Target: 0 | Orange: 1-2 | Red: >=3 | Owner: release-engineering | Measurement: orchestration logs

Acceptance Gates (must be green to graduate traffic stage):
- Security: No open P0/P1 findings in last 72h (owner: security-and-compliance)
- Observability: Traces and logs show correlated request ids across services for 99% of sampled traces (owner: observability)
- Rollout: Canary cohort retention loss <= 2% vs control in 24h (owner: product-hosted-api)
- Cost: Forecasted daily run-rate within committed budget +/- 10% (owner: finance-and-legal)

SLO Sampler (templates you can drop into dashboards):
- SLO name: "Final-mile API availability"
  - SLI: successful 2xx responses / total requests
  - Objective: 99.95% over 7d
  - Burn policy: slide to on-call page if 99.9% breached in 12h

- SLO name: "Prompt latency (production)"
  - SLI: p95 of end-to-end request (client->response) excluding queue time
  - Objective: 200ms p95
  - Measurement: synthetic + sampling of production prod traces

Contingency playbook (short form):
- Orange trigger (single metric > orange threshold):
  - Notify #launch-ops, attach 6h window snapshot and recent deploy IDs
  - Run quick diagnostic checklist (list below)
  - Prepare warm fallback (model variant with half the context length, reduced batch)

- Red trigger (any metric > red threshold or two orange in different domains):
  - Immediately flip to fallback route (traffic router policy id: fallback-2026-1)
  - Open incident in JIRA with severity TAG:launch-red and assign to on-call committee
  - Pause further traffic increases and hold for 30m observation window

Quick diagnostic checklist (6 items):
1) Rollout ID and git sha verified
2) Parameter changes (batch size, quantization) listed
3) Recent infra events (node down, preempt) pulled from SRE logs
4) Model serving container logs for OOM / long GC
5) KV cache cold-start metrics (miss spike?)
6) External dependency health (feature flags, auth, KMS)

Open questions / notes to hammer down pre-cutover:
- What is the canonical runbook URL we use for fallback policy? (target: confluence link)
- Do we want automatic soft-fallback on token-cost spikes or manual only? (product-ops decision)
- Confirm final alert thresholds with finance for cost-based throttles.

Post-cutover (48h stabilization checklist):
- Run rolling quality evals every 6h for first 48h and record differences in the "post-cutover-evals" sheet
- Finance: reconcile actual vs forecasted token spend and flag >10% variance
- Product: 1:1 with top 5 early customers for feedback (owner: customer-success)

Notes and provenance:
- This is intentionally compact to be used as a live checklist in the war room. Longer playbook lives in confluence: confluence:PRODOPS/final-mile-expanded
- Linked artifacts: JIRA:POPS-8124 (ramp schedule), github:repo/rollouts/pull/42 (router policy), confluence:PRODOPS/Final-mile-playbook

Change log (high level):
- 2025-11-03 created by Aisha Patel — baseline checklist and scoreboard
- 2026-01-15 add SLO sampler entries after tabletop with SRE
- 2026-03-01 adjusted latency thresholds after staging run
